summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, furnishing a press release that announces its first quarter 2026 financial and operational results. The release highlights a 156% revenue increase to $15.4 million, a 72% gross profit margin, a narrowed net loss of $7.4 million, and an Adjusted EBITDA improvement to $(0.5) million, all compared to the prior year. The company reaffirms full-year guidance. This filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC-related action, or abrupt management change. Thus, no special-situations category applies; the filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer.
